name: unresolved_vs_resolved_eval
description: Held-out binary ASNE contrast for an open issue versus the same issue being clarified or handled.

items.text: A person reloads the page and still sees no reservation in the list.
Someone returns to the lobby and sees the elevator doors closed after another delay.
A person checks the counter again and sees no badge beside the folded jacket.
A person reloads the page and sees the reservation appear in the list.
Someone returns to the lobby and sees the elevator doors open after the repair crew leaves.
A person checks the counter again and sees the badge beside the folded jacket.
